itemized.notes: A wholly inactive committee's year-end filing: BOTH schedules are blank apart from a hand-written 'n/a' ('n/A' on Schedule B) placed in the NAME column of the first row, and all four total cells carry a hand-drawn SLASHED ZERO. The 'n/a' rows are NOT emitted as itemized rows - 'not applicable' names no donor or vendor and its amount cell holds a zero glyph, so treating it as a transaction would fabricate one; the placeholder is recorded here instead. Per the repo ZERO-GLYPH RULING the slashed zeros ARE zeros (not blanks), which is what makes both sides honest zeros rather than unknowns. Consistent with the Summary Page, which carries accounting-parenthesis balances of (11,487.42) on lines 3/5/7 and slashed zeros on lines 1/2/4/6. LABEL DISAGREEMENT carried over from the totals tranche: the clerk listing calls this 'Amendment to 2012 Summary Report' but the form checks only the Year-End box and leaves both amendment boxes unticked; and this document is page-for-page identical in content to key 509f34ed (not in this chunk).
